what: Rows come in a fixed order
title: Joins without surprises
text: inner join keeps pair matching rows. pairs come order x’s rows, within one row x order y’s, result reads like orders names attached. Order 2 appears twice, customer 20 people twice. Order 5 gone: person customer 30.
code: join(orders, people, on = customer) #> <zutable> 5 rows x 3 columns #>   order   customer name #>   <int32> <int32>  <string> #> 1 1       10       Ada #> 2 2       20       Linus #> 3 2       20       Grace #> 4 3       10       Ada #> 5 4       NA       Nobody

title: Joins without surprises
